Sam (Comms): Quick proposal 1: swap 'Customer Stories' and 'Live Q&A' so we hit more live customer questions while execs are on. Can presenters adapt?
Diego (Eng): Fine with that. Two asks: (1) give video ops + infra a 12m lead for pre-roll checks, (2) ensure we have a warm spare encoder.
Rina (Product): Works for product team. We'll shorten demos by 3m to keep total time same. I'll upload the trimmed demo clip by Wed noon.
Theo (Video Ops): Flag: last time an external guest's camera froze for ~45s when we switched scenes. Suspect HDMI-DUO capture glitch. I'll add scene hold timers.
Marta (Infra): Pre-warm encoder-2 now and mirror ingest to us-east-1. StreamBot: /prewarm-encoder --id encoder-2 --region us-east-1
StreamBot: prewarm job submitted (id q4x7). encoder-2: booting, healthcheck: pending.
Sam (Comms): @Avery preference on Q&A placement? Execs asked to keep it "open floor" time.
Avery (CEO): Put Q&A immediately after leadership updates, keep it 30m. If video hiccups, continue audio + Slack thread. Good to have parking-lot doc for deep follow-ups.
Diego (Eng): For failover: recommend automated encoder handoff + phone bridge fallback. Infra can publish a short runbook.
Theo (Video Ops): Phone bridge fallback is good. Here's the quick local backup command I use for encoder fallback recording:
```
# fallback record using ffmpeg to local drive
ffmpeg -f alsa -i hw:0 -f v4l2 -i /dev/video0 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -r 30 -c:a aac /srv/backup/allhands-fallback.mp4
```
Rina (Product): Small content ask: add one slide clarifying Dedicated vs Private feature parity (2 bullets). Makes Q&A answers simpler.
Sam (Comms): I'll update the agenda doc and DM presenters. Also assigning a chat moderator to triage incoming questions.
Marta (Infra): Health update: encoder-2 boot ok, mirroring to us-east-1 established, ingest P50=120ms, P95=420ms. StreamBot: job q4x7 status: healthy.
Theo (Video Ops): Ops checklist for the event:
- OBS scenes tested and scene-hold at 5s
- switcher firmware 1.3.2 installed
- encoder-2 warm, RTMP mirror active
- local ffmpeg fallback ready on laptop
- captions agent warmed and test captions run
Diego (Eng): Can someone add a tiny widget to the all-hands page showing ingest latency and active viewers? I can feed the metric but need the slot.
Sam (Comms): Adding to runbook. If captions lag again, we'll pause captions and post transcript + highlight clip within 45m.
Avery (CEO): During the live Q&A, if an answer needs cross-team follow-up, tag it with "follow-up:" and assign an owner. Keep live replies brief.
Rina (Product): I'll prepare a "parking lot" doc for deeper roadmap questions and send link after the all-hands.
Theo (Video Ops): Running a full AV dry-run Thu 08:30 PT. Please join. I'll attach a short test video and a remote guest NDI feed.
Sam (Comms): Great. I'll post the updated agenda + runbook link in #all-hands in 20m. :rocket:
Marta (Infra): StreamBot: job q4x7 final status: encoder-2 healthy, rtcp checks OK, failover ready.
